# Eldorado’s Skouries mine wins EU strategic status

[Marina Meireles](https://www.mining.com/author/marina-meirelesearthlabs-com/) | October 13, 2026 | 7:57 am  [Critical Minerals](https://www.mining.com/category/critical-minerals/) [Regulatory Issues](https://www.mining.com/category/regulatory-issues/) [Canada](https://www.mining.com/region/canada/) [Europe](https://www.mining.com/region/europe/) [Copper](https://www.mining.com/commodity/copper/) [Gold](https://www.mining.com/commodity/gold/)

![Eldorado Gold closer to begin construction at Skouries in Greece](https://www.mining.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Kassandra_Mines.jpeg)

The Skouries project is part of the Kassandra Mines Complex. (*Image courtesy of [Eldorado Gold.](https://www.eldoradogold.com/assets/operations-and-projects/europe/projects/skouries-greece/default.aspx)*)

The European Commission has granted strategic status to Eldorado Gold’s (TSX: ELD, NYSE: EGO) Skouries copper-gold mine in Greece, positioning one of Europe’s largest new mining projects for faster permitting and improved access to financing as it ramps up production.

The designation, the Canadian miner [announced](https://www.eldoradogold.com/investors/news-releases/eldorado-golds-skouries-mine-designated-strategic-project-under-eu-critical) on Oct. 9, places Skouries among 46 projects selected under the EU’s Critical Raw Materials Act (CRMA).

The backing comes as the EU looks to strengthen its domestic supply chain of critical metals and enhance long-term supply, breaking free from its reliance on China for them. Copper is included in the list as it is essential for Europe’s electrification, manufacturing, and the energy transition.

“As one of the largest new copper-gold mines in Europe, Skouries is positioned to support the secure and responsible supply of critical raw materials that are essential to economic growth, industrial competitiveness and the energy transition,” Eldorado CEO Christian Milau said. “This recognition highlights the strategic significance of the project and the important role it can play in strengthening Europe’s long-term supply chain resilience.”

Skouries is among 46 projects selected by the EU that will benefit from faster permitting and help in bidding for public and private funding, not immediately receiving funding from the Commission.

Shares in Eldorado Gold were down 3.03% to C$52.09 ($36.62) apiece on Tuesday morning in Toronto, valuing the company at C$13.6 billion ($9.5 billion).
